name: REA Safe Agent
description: A skill and Python controller that contain REA and its receiving coding agent in separate restricted Docker containers for static analysis of untrusted files. Verified runtime scope: Linux and macOS; Windows Docker integration is experimental.
general_comments: Evidence-based maintainer self-assessment started on 2026-10-19. This is not an independent security audit. Unknown or incomplete criteria remain explicit. Whole-image vulnerability findings remain documented; a clean npm or Scorecard check does not establish clean container images.

crypto_keylength_justification: TLS uses ssl.create_default_context(). This assessment has not verified the full key-length and forward-secrecy requirements across every supported platform and endpoint.

crypto_working_justification: Original controller integrity uses SHA-256 and provider HTTPS uses certificate-verified default TLS contexts; no custom or deliberately weakened cipher configuration. https://github.com/dagoSte/rea-safe-agents/blob/main/skills/rea-isolated/scripts/agent_container.py
crypto_weaknesses_justification: Original controller integrity uses SHA-256 and provider HTTPS uses certificate-verified default TLS contexts; no custom or deliberately weakened cipher configuration. https://github.com/dagoSte/rea-safe-agents/blob/main/skills/rea-isolated/scripts/agent_container.py
crypto_password_storage_justification: The project does not implement inbound password authentication or a password database. Provider subscription tokens are outbound credentials, handled under the documented security model. https://github.com/dagoSte/rea-safe-agents/blob/main/skills/rea-isolated/references/security-model.md
crypto_random_justification: Cryptographic keys and TLS nonces are delegated to Python ssl/OpenSSL; original code does not generate cryptographic keys with a non-cryptographic random generator. Deterministic test seeds are only test inputs. https://github.com/dagoSte/rea-safe-agents/blob/main/skills/rea-isolated/scripts/agent_container.py
